planets.name: TOI-4511 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-4511 with a 11-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: TOI-4511 b crosses its star every 11 days and is 2.8 times as wide as Earth, found in 2026.
text.introduction: TOI-4511 b transits TOI-4511 every 11 days and is 2.8 times as wide as Earth. Orbit and size follow Lafarga et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
